verdict.rationale: The only nearby feature is Open Quickly (Cmd-Shift-O). The evidence describes it only as a search for navigating sessions by tab title, command, hostname, directory or badge. Nothing shows a searchable palette for discovering and running terminal actions or menu commands. Session navigation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward an action command palette.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can discover and run terminal actions from a searchable command palette
